| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Cleaned image | Cleaned image, Removed pattern | The cleaned image, or what was removed, around a mid gray of 128. |
| **Peak threshold** `threshold` | 0.5 | 0.1 to 4 | A frequency is the core of a peak where its log magnitude is this much above the highest value on the ring around it. 0.5 means about 1.6 times as large. |
| **Lowest frequency** `minRadius` | 0.1 | 0.01 to 0.45 cycles/px | Peaks are looked for only at this frequency or above, so the broad shapes of the image are safe. 0.1 is a period of 10 pixels. |
| **Ring size** `window` | 41 | 9 to 81 | The outer diameter of the ring each frequency is compared with, in frequency bins. |
| **Peak spread** `spread` | 5 | 0 to 10 | Each peak core is widened by this many frequency bins in every direction. The ring starts at the spread plus 1. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
